recommended_frozen_algorithm.input_date: Already adjudicated Gregorian civil yyyy-mm-dd; no lunar/Julian conversion here. Do not alter any selected DOB.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.reference_offset: Fixed UTC+08:00 library convention; no geographical/time-zone/longitude/historical DST adjustment.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.placeholder: 12:00:00 on that numeric civil date for computation only; not an imputed birth time.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.year: ec.getYear(): Exact LiChun transition instant, not January1 or Lunar New Year.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.month: ec.getMonth(): Exact12Jie transition instants, not lunar month or all24solar terms.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.day: ec.getDay() with explicit sect2: midnight civil date rollover; no23:00 rollover.
recommended_frozen_algorithm.hour_pillar: Do not use noon hour pillar as observed birth-hour data.

boundary_flags.term_civil_day: true if d==date(term) for any of12Jie in fixedUTC+8; LiChun also year_boundary_day.
boundary_flags.near_Jie_1day: true iff any of12Jie has abs((d-date(term)).days)<=1, inclusive.
boundary_flags.record: retain term name/time, signed civil-day delta, fixed-noon year/month choices; flags do not change DOB or choose a birth time.
boundary_flags.implementation: Build term timestamps for adjacent calendar years, normalize English duplicate aliases, deduplicate timestamps; use all0:00:00..23:59:59 if checking intraday change, not0:30..22:30.
boundary_flags.interpretation: Conservative date/algorithm sensitivity flag, not proof of an astronomical or source conflict.

independence_limits: sxtwl and lunar_python both reference ShouXing astronomical calendar algorithms: cross-implementation corroboration, not fully independent astronomical theory.
The integer GregorianJDN computation is independently implemented here, while the phase relationcycle=(JDN+49)%60 is an explicit conventional calibration checked with sxtwl.
OfficialHKO fixtures check civil-to-lunar conversion only; HKOyear field changes at LunarNewYear and is not an oracle for the selectedLiChun year pillar.
NAOJ publishes minute precision; these checks do not establish second-level ephemeris accuracy over1835–1985.
No cross-cohort or person-level output, feature distribution, p-value or substantive inference was inspected.
